svg.text: then the front of the sequence

Figure 9: MiniMax-H3, text to video with sound, in the style of Vaswani et al. (2017). A prompt is encoded by a 50-layer Qwen3-VL language model; a diffusion transformer denoises video and audio latents together, in one sequence with the prompt, its norms

and residual adds modulated per modality by AdaLN vectors computed from the timestep; a ViT decodes the video latents into frames and BigVGAN the audio latents into a 32 kHz soundtrack. The four networks run one after the other; every box drawn as a product
runs as an f16 tensor-core GEMM, the quantized ones after their slices are expanded to f16.
